svg.title: Photo Score — A fresh look at your photos.
svg.desc: Original illustrative artwork, not an application screenshot. Light, Color, and Detail sliders move in staggered waves. The sun and moon linger overhead, then rapidly set and rise together through sunset and sunrise. A focus pointer visits varied positions with pauses between moves. Reduced motion shows a still daytime view. Yeony creative tools.

g.aria-label: A fresh look at your photos.
